name: headmesh
description: Agent sandboxes on your own machines over a private Headscale mesh

sandbox_url.title: Sandbox MCP URL
sandbox_url.description: The headmesh-sandboxd endpoint, either its MagicDNS URL on your tailnet or its Headmesh ingress URL.

sandbox_token.title: Sandbox token
sandbox_token.description: The bearer token (starts with hms_) that your sandbox issued for this client. Stored in your system keychain.
